authority: T0 exact finite-regulator quantum-state construction and selection-obstruction certificate; not a TECT claim, tier change, boundary-algebra theorem, continuum or Hadamard theorem, physical-vacuum theorem, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
statement: After explicitly declaring hbar>0 and the canonical momentum p=(a/8)Pi, every fixed periodic CL8 regulator quantizes on L2(R^(8M)) as a uniformly elliptic Schrodinger operator Hhat_a=-(4hbar^2/(a chi))Delta+U_a with a coercive real quartic potential. Its Friedrichs realization is self-adjoint with compact resolvent, a simple strictly positive normalized ground wavefunction, and a trace-class faithful Gibbs density for every beta>0. These density matrices define normal states on B(L2(R^(8M))) and restrict to the regular Weyl CCR algebra. The ground projector is selected uniquely once the ground-state criterion is declared, while all thermal Gibbs densities are also stationary and preserve the same periodic CL8 node/coarse-translation, Q3, and global-Z2 symmetries. Thus normalization, quantum stationarity, and those exact symmetries alone do not select one preferred fixed-regulator quantum state. The construction has no proved nonlinear quantum characteristic-boundary map, regulator limit, interacting continuum algebra, Hadamard property, physical empty-space interpretation, or below-empty-space energy comparison.
verdict: CLOSE THE FINITE-REGULATOR QUANTUM GROUND-AND-GIBBS CONSTRUCTION; FORMALLY REJECT STATIONARITY-AND-SYMMETRY-ONLY PREFERENCE; KEEP QUANTUM BOUNDARY, CONTINUUM, HADAMARD, PHYSICAL REFERENCE, CP1, AND PRE-A OPEN

quantization.domain: T_L=R/(LZ), finite M>=2, a=L/M, d=8M real configuration coordinates q_(j,e)
quantization.classical_symplectic_weight: w=a/8 in Omega_a=w sum dPi_i wedge dq_i
quantization.canonical_momentum: p_i=w*Pi_i, so Omega_a=sum dp_i wedge dq_i
quantization.parameter_domain: L>0, finite M>=2, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>=0, r real, hbar>0

state_algebra.observable_algebra: B(H_a), where H_a=L2(R^d,dq); H_a is infinite-dimensional even though d=8M is finite
state_algebra.regular_CCR_algebra: the Weyl unitaries generated by the declared finite canonical pairs in the regular Schrodinger representation
state_algebra.normal_state: a positive trace-class density rho defines omega_rho(A)=Tr(rho A) on B(H_a), and hence a state by restriction to the regular Weyl algebra
state_algebra.stationarity: alpha_t(A)=exp(i t Hhat_a/hbar) A exp(-i t Hhat_a/hbar); every density used here commutes with Hhat_a and therefore omega_rho composed with alpha_t equals omega_rho
state_algebra.dynamics_boundary: the stationarity no-go is on B(H_a), where alpha_t is an automorphism; preservation of the regular Weyl C-star algebra by the interacting dynamics is not proved

coercive_operator_theorem.quadratic_form: h_a[f]=kappa_a||grad f||_2^2+integral U_a|f|^2 on the closure of C_c^infinity under its shifted form norm
coercive_operator_theorem.self_adjointness: the closed lower-bounded form defines the Friedrichs self-adjoint operator Hhat_a
coercive_operator_theorem.compact_resolvent: the harmonic lower bound controls tails and Rellich compactness controls bounded balls, so the form-domain embedding into L2 is compact
coercive_operator_theorem.ground_state: the lowest eigenvalue is attained; positivity improvement of the scalar Schrodinger heat semigroup on the finite-dimensional configuration space R^d makes it simple with a smooth strictly positive normalized wavefunction
coercive_operator_theorem.symmetry: periodic CL8 node/coarse translations, Q3 automorphisms, and global q-to-minus-q commute with Hhat_a; fine one-site ST8 translation is not claimed; simplicity makes the ground state invariant and Z2 even
coercive_operator_theorem.finite_volume_boundary: the unique even ground does not select any one classical ordered well; for lambda>0 this includes the two collective plus-or-minus-v wells, while lambda=0 has a larger sign-minimum set. No spontaneous symmetry breaking or uniform spectral gap is proved

thermal_state_theorem.oscillator_comparison: Hhat_a>=H_osc-C_mu with H_osc=-kappa_a Delta+mu|q|^2 and omega=sqrt(kappa_a*mu)
thermal_state_theorem.heat_trace_bound: Tr exp(-beta Hhat_a)<=exp(beta C_mu)[exp(-beta omega)/(1-exp(-2beta omega))]^d for every beta>0
thermal_state_theorem.Gibbs_density: rho_(a,beta)=Z_(a,beta)^(-1)exp(-beta Hhat_a) is positive, faithful, trace class, normalized and stationary for every beta>0
thermal_state_theorem.zero_temperature_limit: with Delta=E_1-E_0>0 and R_beta=sum_(n>=1) exp[-beta(E_n-E_0)], heat-trace finiteness at beta_0 gives R_beta<=exp[-(beta-beta_0)Delta]R_(beta_0) and ||rho_(a,beta)-P_(0,a)||_1=2R_beta/(1+R_beta), hence trace-norm convergence as beta tends to infinity
thermal_state_theorem.symmetries: every rho_(a,beta) preserves periodic CL8 node/coarse translations, Q3 automorphisms and global Z2; fine one-site ST8 translation is not claimed
thermal_state_theorem.distinctness: the ground projector is pure while each finite-beta Gibbs density is faithful and mixed; different beta values give different spectral weights

formal_selection_no_go.excluded_route: uniquely select a preferred fixed-regulator normal state on B(L2(R^(8M))) using only normalization, stationarity under Hhat_a, and the declared exact periodic CL8 node/coarse-translation, Q3 and global-Z2 symmetries
formal_selection_no_go.witness: the simple ground projector and every faithful finite-beta Gibbs density satisfy all listed conditions and are distinct
formal_selection_no_go.not_excluded: selection after an independently justified ground-state, KMS temperature, energy, reservoir, preparation-history, symmetry-breaking, boundary, or cosmological condition

conditional_ground_selection.rule: minimize the spectrum of the declared Hhat_a and require a normalized vector state
conditional_ground_selection.result: the positivity-improving theorem selects one unique finite-a ground projector
conditional_ground_selection.inserted_status: the ground-state selection criterion and hbar are declared inputs, not outputs of the classical CL8 dynamics or Pre-A history; no physical justification of that criterion is derived
conditional_ground_selection.ordered_phase_boundary: the fixed-regulator ground is Z2 even; its odd order parameters vanish and it is not one pure classical ordered phase

energy_shift_boundary.Goursat_shift: adding C_star=2r_minus^2/g to W adds L*C_star/8 to Hhat_a
energy_shift_boundary.state_invariance: the additive scalar shifts every eigenvalue and free energy and rescales the unnormalized heat kernel, but leaves the normalized ground projector and Gibbs density unchanged
energy_shift_boundary.physical_boundary: the shift proves freedom of the absolute energy origin but cancels in relative energy differences. A below-empty-space comparison remains absent because no state representing physical empty space or the no-condensate reference has been identified on the same regulator and normalization

boundary_composition_fork.finite_algebra: the package constructs fixed-regulator normal states on B(L2(R^(8M))) and their restrictions to the regular Weyl CCR algebra only; the Hilbert space is not finite-dimensional
boundary_composition_fork.classical_map_boundary: the nonlinear classical Goursat solution map and variational symplectic flux are not a quantum star-homomorphism or unitary intertwiner
boundary_composition_fork.position_marginal_boundary: |Psi_0(q)|^2 dq is only a configuration marginal and is not an invariant positive classical phase-space measure
boundary_composition_fork.continuum_boundary: the Hilbert spaces and CCR algebras change with M; no compatible embeddings, counterterms, state tightness, algebraic limit, or interacting continuum construction is proved
boundary_composition_fork.nonuniformity: the radial quartic coefficient a*g/(32d)=L*g/(256M^2) deteriorates with M, so the present coercive heat-trace bound is not cutoff uniform
boundary_composition_fork.Hadamard_boundary: a finite lattice has no continuum wavefront-set singularity; no microlocal spectrum or Hadamard theorem follows
boundary_composition_fork.common_parent_boundary: no one quantum state and energy reference is yet composed with the three-dimensional ordering sector

hostile_boundaries.compact_resolvent_not_heat_trace: compact resolvent alone is not used to claim trace class; the explicit harmonic comparison supplies the heat-trace bound
hostile_boundaries.positive_wavefunction_not_positive_energ: strict positivity refers to the ground wavefunction, not the sign of its eigenvalue
hostile_boundaries.finite_gap_not_uniform_gap: a positive first finite-volume spectral gap follows from discrete simplicity but no regulator-uniform or thermodynamic gap is claimed
hostile_boundaries.symmetry_not_order: a unique symmetric finite-volume ground does not select one broken-symmetry classical well
hostile_boundaries.stationarity_not_preference: the whole thermal family is stationary and symmetric, so an extra state criterion is indispensable
hostile_boundaries.finite_state_not_Hadamard: finite-dimensional configuration space and finite lattice spacing do not certify continuum locality or a Hadamard singularity
hostile_boundaries.quantum_state_not_classical_measure: a density operator or its position marginal cannot silently replace the classical phase measure required by the composition theorem

inserted_inputs: the finite periodic CL8 Hamiltonian and a/8 symplectic normalization
hbar>0 and the canonical CCR representation
the ground-state criterion when unique ground selection is invoked
beta>0 when a thermal state is invoked
derived_outputs: the radial quartic and harmonic coercive bounds
Friedrichs self-adjointness, compact resolvent and a simple ground with a strictly positive wavefunction
the explicit finite-beta heat-trace bound and Gibbs density
the boundary, continuum and Hadamard gate split

Pre_A_chain_role.N1_boundary: not established: no characteristic-boundary observable algebra or state is constructed, and the Gaussian C0-A finite-image boundary comparator is not superseded
Pre_A_chain_role.N2_through_N5: not established: there is no quantum boundary reconstruction, derived cooling history, limiting phase-transition theorem, or emergent bulk geometry and excitation theorem

prior_art_boundary: Friedrichs forms, compact embeddings for confining Schrodinger operators, positivity-improving ground-state uniqueness, harmonic-oscillator comparison, normal density-matrix states, and fixed-regulator Gibbs operators are established mathematics. No world-first or new general operator theorem is claimed. The repository-specific result is the exact CL8/Q3 a/8-to-CCR normalization, fixed-regulator construction, additive-shift audit, and precise boundary/continuum/physical-selection gate split.
no_overclaim: This package constructs the declared fixed-regulator CL8 Schrodinger ground and thermal Gibbs normal states and refutes only unique quantum preference from stationarity and the listed exact symmetries alone. It does not derive hbar or the ground/KMS criterion, select a pure ordered finite-volume phase, turn a position marginal into a classical phase measure, construct a quantum characteristic-boundary algebra map, prove preservation of the regular Weyl C-star algebra by the interacting dynamics, prove state compatibility under regulator removal, build an interacting continuum or Hadamard state, identify physical empty space, establish an absolute or below-empty-space energy sign, reach a thermodynamic limit, derive full 3+1 dynamics, gravity or cooling, close C0 or any N1-N5 link, advance C6, complete CP1, or complete Pre-A.
